checks.rule: Only CNY/¥ and EUR/€ may appear in final workbook price fields.
Any non-CNY evidence selected for display is converted to EUR/€ at export time; no other currency is shown.
Converted values retain FX date/source in export metadata; original amount/currency remains only in internal evidence JSON.
Source market + evidence status remain visible after conversion, preventing EUR conversion from being misread as an EU-native market quote or a China RMB band.

checks.evidence: Hole rule, photo coverage, specialist model, no-direct-purchase, gold-tone hold, non-elastic structure-pending and zero purchase approval remain unchanged from pre-excel-audit-v1.

excel_currency_rule: Final workbook price fields may display only ¥ or €. No other currency symbol/code appears in user-visible sheets.
